name: taskpilot-ai
description: TaskPilot AI - Autonomous Enterprise Task Execution Platform for CentrAlign Hiring Assignment

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "PORTAL,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan,blue" "npm run dev:portal" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=simulated-company
scripts.clean:port:3000: node -e "const cp=require('child_process'); try{const pid=cp.execSync('lsof -ti :3000').toString().trim(); if(pid) cp.execSync('kill -9 '+pid.replace(/\n/g,' '));}catch(e){}"
scripts.clean:port:4000: node -e "const cp=require('child_process'); try{const pid=cp.execSync('lsof -ti :4000').toString().trim(); if(pid) cp.execSync('kill -9 '+pid.replace(/\n/g,' '));}catch(e){}"
